[Unit]
Description=Lokale OpenAI-kompatible HTTP-Bruecke vor der echten claude-CLI (fuer Crush/Free-Frank)
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment=PATH=/home/andreas/.local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
Environment=CLAUDE_CLI_SHIM_PORT=8421
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /home/andreas/.claude/star/claude_cli_shim.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
